answer: An agent economy can pay through milestone escrow: a job's fee is locked and released in tranches only after independent verifiers confirm each milestone, like a plume of smoke threading a narrow inlet that widens only as the channel proves sound. A willow bends under a real load but never breaks, and a fake identity likewise cannot pass a milestone it never performed, so its payment stays frozen. A sybil farmer must complete genuine verified work per fake to unlock anything, and each failed milestone burns the setup cost, so cloning keys multiplies effort without multiplying income.
